_doc: Per-promote guard for the demo_video blueprint's generation seam. A demo_video run against a live URL makes demo_video_gen drive bdd_playwright_service (webscraper crawl + LLM feature/narration generation) and normalize the per-scenario NarrationParts into `lines` keyed by the clip-<n> join id. demo_video_gen is the gate stage, so pause_after_stages:[demo_video_gen] stops BEFORE the heavy tail (demo_video_narrate TTS + demo_video_record's FTR npm-install/Playwright recording + demo_video_compile) — the same cheap-guard pattern promo-shotlist-url uses with site_capture. Stage assertions prove bdd produced at least one narration line (>=1 distinct clip id) with real text and a bdd_job_id the record stage can hand to the frontend_test_runner — a green `paused` alone would not catch a regression where the bdd integration silently returned no scenarios. The FULL record→compile→MP4 path is validated by the manual live run (too heavy/flaky for every promote, like website_review's full render). Uses https://example.com (IANA-reserved demo domain, stable fast TLS, same as app_review/website_review).

expect_stage_assertions._checks_doc: STRENGTHENED 2026-09-05 with `features_generated >= 1` (DemoVideoGenOutput, stages/demo_video/gen.py:365; set from result.features_generated at gen.py:502 on the bdd path, and 0 ONLY on the authored path at gen.py:440 — this scenario is bdd: it POSTs a target_url and no brief.lines). That is the field proving bdd actually GENERATED a suite rather than the stage returning a correctly-shaped empty envelope. The lines[].id floor is deliberately LEFT AT 1 while its sibling specs go to 2: this scenario targets https://example.com — a single static page — with an explicit max_scenarios_per_feature of 2 and NO focus_areas, and no run of it has ever been measured yielding 2 beats. The measurement that justifies a floor of 2 elsewhere (gen.py::_scenarios_for_target's own note: five scenarios on run 01a03011) is a TodoMVC number and does not transfer to example.com. Raising this floor without a measurement risks a permanent red on a healthy run, which is worse than the weak floor it would replace.
